September 17 – November 5, 2025 Wednesdays | 7:30 – 8:45 pm | Ages 16+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Take your guitar skills to the next level in this 8-week intermediate class! Building on your knowledge of chords and strumming, you’ll explore more complex techniques such as fingerpicking, barre chords, and soloing. Learn to play more challenging songs, improve your rhythm, and develop a deeper understanding of music theory. This class is perfect for those who are ready to expand their playing and gain more confidence in their musical abilities. Students must bring their own guitar (acoustic).
